verdicts.q: What was the theme of the 18th BRICS Summit held in New Delhi on 12-13 September 2026 under India's chairship?
verdicts.note: Theme, dates, New Delhi Declaration and China 2027 confirmed on SAnews. Bharat Mandapam venue not confirmed, so removed. India's 4th chairship (2012, 2016, 2021, 2026) is correct.

fix.explanation: The theme was 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'. The summit was held in New Delhi on 12-13 September 2026, adopted the New Delhi Declaration and was India's 4th BRICS chairship (after 2012, 2016 and 2021). China chairs BRICS in 2027. Source: SAnews (South African Government), 13 Sep 2026.

verdicts.q: The 26th meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State, which marked 25 years of the organisation, was held on 31 August-1 September 2026 in which city?

fix.q: The 26th meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State, which marked 25 years of the organisation, was held on 1 September 2026 in which city?
fix.explanation: The summit was held on 1 September 2026 at the Yrys-Ordo Congress Hall in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, and was chaired by President Sadyr Japarov. Pakistan took over the chair for 2026-27, and Lahore was named SCO Tourism and Cultural Capital for 2026-27. Source: SCO Secretariat, 1 Sep 2026.

verdicts.q: On which date did the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) come into force?

fix.explanation: CETA came into force on 15 July 2026. It was signed on 24 July 2025 and gives duty-free access to about 99% of India's exports to the UK (by tariff lines). Source: GOV.UK, Jul 2026.

fix.q: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement, signed in New Delhi in April 2026, came into force on which date?
